title: Understanding Convex Functions
text: A convex function has a unique global minimum. This means that the optimal value of a parameter in a convex function is the point where the function reaches its lowest value.

title: Gradient Descent Insight
text: In gradient descent, the parameter is updated in the direction that reduces the function value. If the function is convex, this means moving towards the minimum.

title: Comparing Values
text: Given that the function is convex and the parameter is updated to minimize the function, how does the new parameter value compare to the initial one?
